releases.body:
# Am MOD r30a

The first release with the mixer, the input channel, resampling through the mixer and the tuner. Firmware **1.3.0.12** only.

## Read this first

- **The "SD Card Access" item is hidden** in the Project menu (Shift+Pad 16) in both modes. USB transfer mode ("the card as a drive on your computer") cannot work while the mod runs: the app runs in an isolated copy without access to raw storage devices, and the card is in use by the mod. The item was removed for safety. Use a card reader; to get USB mode back, remove `autorun/` from the card and start the MPC.
- **Two modes: Stock and Am MOD.** Project → Mod Settings → Quick → FX mode, applied after a restart. *Stock*: the stock FX Select (one effect), no mixer. *Am MOD*: the mixer replaces FX Select; Knob FX opens the mixer; a stock FX Select effect saved in a project is ignored. Signal-path diagrams for both modes (EN/RU) are in the README.
- Back up projects and samples before updating. Save to **External**.

## What is new

- **Mixer**: tracks A–H and Master, four insert effects per track, sends, sidechain, Song stems to the SD card.
- **Input channel** (mixer pad 15): Level, Pan, Mute, Input FX; recording point **Input / Track A–H / Master**, **Wet / Dry**; monitoring follows the record point; Rear modes.
- **Resample** a pad (Shift+Pad 11 in Sample) or a sequence (Shift+Pad 11 in Seq) through the mixer, with a destination dialog, Replace confirmation, stop confirmation and independent bank handling.
- **Tuner**: input (mixer Input ROUTE, Sample Record B3) and the sample of any pad (Stop+Chop in Sample); B3 "Orig note" stores the original note.
- **Pad colour from Track** on every screen with pad sounds.
- New illustrated effect screens, typing names with the pads, Master compressor OptoCat/Duck.

## Bugs fixed

- Save Project / Save Sample: false "Insert SD card" and saving to Internal.
- Stems export with an External Export window; the Stems name window now accepts pads at once.
- Resampled pad lost its attack; sequence resample skipped the mixer and could be silent at first start.
- Recording through Track or Master stayed dry.
- A stock FX Select effect sounded in Am MOD; one selected pad made Knob FX hit every pad.
- Pad colours turned stock under native dialogs.
- Resample dialog: Pad Bank stepping, bank letters, stop confirmation, Replace prompt with red target and hint (sequences), destination bank independent of the sequence bank.
- Compressor pad pick showed free-green / occupied-red like a destination: now a normal blinking selection.
- Seq+Sample window lit pads differently from Sample: now the same rules.
- Shift+Erase in the mixer started the stock copy gesture; K3 Volume in the sample library blinked; Master FX pinned Sample Comp row.

## Known

- Rare short crackle in the tuner window on very low notes.
- A missing sequence cursor in Song was seen once and could not be reproduced.

## Thanks

Huge thanks to **Leusha** for careful, detailed testing and for finding bugs: most of the fixes above started from those reports. Thanks also to mxt1iga and everyone who tested builds.

releases.body:
# Am MOD r29a — new effect screens, SD stems and pad typing Release for Akai MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12**, 13 November 2026. Replaces the pre-release r28e-fx2 (and r28e-fx3 … fx16, which were test builds). Host and package checks passed; the new Save, Stems and text-input behaviour was tried on a device while it was being built. **Back up projects and samples before updating.** Projects that use the effects added in r28e-fx2 do not load in older Am MOD versions.
Tape Delay
 Tape (cassette)
Vinyl
 Spring Reverb
Tube Drive
 Multi Chorus
Pitch Shifter
 Ensemble
Frames rendered from the mod's own painter with a test signal, not recorded from a device. More animations are in [media/fx](media/fx). ## What's new - **New effect screens.** Every effect picture was redrawn: the value strip under the picture is gone (the values are on the parameter panel), each picture has a small *AM MOD* plate in its category colour, and many are now a real object. **Tape Delay** is a reel-to-reel with wooden cheeks, tape running tangentially to guide rollers and a red erase head. **Tape** is a cassette: the left tape pack, a VU meter whose needle follows the signal level, and **PLAY** / **STOP** keys (PLAY is down while sound runs, STOP when it stops; the reels turn only while playing). **Vinyl** is a turntable with a short tonearm and record shelves on both sides. Also redrawn: Sample Delay, Spring Reverb (spring tank), Tube Drive (glowing tubes), Soft Clipper (transfer curve and waveform), Ensemble (three voices and their sum), Multi Chorus (LFO circle), Auto Wah (pedal and sweep), Pitch Shifter (keyboard), Flanger and Bit Crusher. - **Typing with the pads is the default** wherever a name or text is entered: Search, Save Project / Sample, Export, Stems and track names in the Mixer. **K1 still switches to Encoder.** New Mod Setting: **Quick → Text input: Pads / Encoder**, saved on the card. - **Shift+Erase clears the whole text** in every pad-input window (Search already did). Erase still deletes one character. - **The first Mod Settings tab is now called Quick** (it was Pads); FX view is there. - **Stems go to the SD card** in a folder named after the song: `Samples/User/Export//`. The folder holds one file per sounding Track named `_track A.wav`, or `_track A_.wav` if the Track was renamed, and **`_Master.wav`** (the stock mixdown). ## Fixed - **Save Project and Save Sample could save to Internal.** The windows now open with External selected and force it back to External when K3 is turned. - **Stems export failed** (`SD_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE`) when the stock Export window offered External. Stems now always go to the card, whichever destination the window shows, and no stray mixdown file is left in `Samples/Export`. - **The Stems name window showed Pads but the pads did not respond** until K1 was toggled. Pads now work as soon as the window opens. - **Master FX no longer shows a pinned Sample Comp row.** It only existed after Shift+Pad 5 had been opened once, and the Duck type had no Master view, so it was N/A or missing at start. Add **OptoCat Comp** from the effect list instead. - Tape needles, idle and bypassed pictures and other small drawing issues of the redrawn screens. ## Tested and not yet tested Host checks with sanitizers and the package checks passed, including new tests for the name editor (Pads default, Shift+Erase) and the Text input setting. Tried on a device while building: Save External-only and Stems export (folder, names, Master). Not tested on a device: all redrawn pictures (frame time, readability on the real screen), Shift+Erase in every native window, the Text input setting after a power cycle. ## Known limits - The stock Master FX effect from Pad FX / Program is not shown in the mixer yet. - The Vintage Emulator *Type* list is not named yet. - Seq Record in the mixer is still unused; recording parameter automation is planned. - Auto Wah and Amp Sim pictures are mostly static in the preview animations because the test signal does not move their controls. ## Installation Select `am-mod-r29a.zip` in MPC Sample Mod Installer, or copy its complete `autorun/` folder to the SD card root, replacing the previous mod files. Restart with the card inserted and check r29a in About. Back up first; the installer keeps a copy of the previous `autorun/`. ## How to use 1. **Typing:** names and search open in Pads mode. Press K1 for Encoder. Erase deletes a character, Shift+Erase clears everything. 2. **Default input:** Mod Settings → Quick → Text input. 3. **Stems:** Song → Export → Stems, enter a name; files appear on the card in `Samples/User/Export//`. 4. **Effect pictures:** Mod Settings → Quick → FX view: Illustrated / Classic. [Русский](RELEASE_NOTES-r29a.ru.md)

releases.name: Am MOD r28e — Pad Link, Mute Group and Project Menu
releases.body:
<!-- lang:en -->
Am MOD r28e and Installer 1.3.0

AM Mod for the Akai MPC Sample, firmware 1.3.0.12. Built on r28d; this release collects everything since r28d.

## What's new since r28d

### Sample screen lighting (Pad lighting: Am MOD only)

- **Mute Group** has the same modes as Pad Link: Off / Selected / Playing / Both.
  - *Selected*: the other pads of the selected pad's group alternate between their own colour and the Mute Group colour. The blink starts when you select the pad (group colour first) and playback does not hide it.
  - *Playing*: when a pad of a group is pressed or played (also from the sequencer), the other pads of its group flash the Mute Group colour for 300 ms.
- **Pad Link**: targets of the selected pad alternate between their own colour and the Pad Link colour (Selected); a target flashes briefly when it starts playing (Playing). Blinking stops as soon as another pad is selected.
- Both settings default to **Selected**. Cards that already have saved settings keep them; Restore recommended (Pads) returns Selected/Selected.
- Offset no longer gets any special lighting.

### Mod Settings

- **Colours** tab: separate colours for Pad Link and Mute Group, a new LED strength option (Normal / Strong / Max) for colours that look washed out, and the RGB palette editor shows all 16 slots at full strength with the selected slot flashing white.
- **Pad lighting** is the master setting: with Standard selected, Pad Link, Mute Group and every Colours row are greyed out and locked.

### Project menu

- **Screen Mirror** moved from Mod Settings to the Project menu (seventh row, after Mod Settings). The list scrolls natively.
- Larger font and new icons (note for Key/Scale/Tempo, gear for Mod Settings, computer for Screen Mirror) are planned for a later release.

### Screen Mirror port (new in r28e)

- Screen Mirror now listens on **port 8081**: open `http://192.168.155.1:8081/` (it was 8080). The mpc-boot-thingy boot menu uses `192.168.155.1:8080` for its own web page, so the two could not run together. Screen Mirror is still Off after every restart. Thanks to lutikoff for reporting this.

### Installer 1.3.0 (separate download, `MPC-Sample-Mod-Installer.exe`)

- English / Russian interface and release notes; notes and the installation log are always visible together.
- "Latest release" picks the newest release that has a mod package.
- **mpc-boot-thingy support:** on a card with the boot menu the installer adds AM Mod as a boot-menu app (`autorun/apps/am-mod/`) instead of replacing `autorun/`, so the boot menu keeps working. Choose AM Mod in the boot menu to start it.

## Install

Easiest: run the installer, pick the SD card and press Install. By hand: unzip the package and copy the `autorun` folder to the SD card (exFAT, or FAT32 with this package), then switch the MPC on with the card inserted. Firmware 1.3.0.12 only.

## Status

All host and ARM/QEMU checks pass. Confirmed on the device by the author: Pad Link and Mute Group blinking and flashes, Screen Mirror on port 8081. Not yet confirmed on hardware: Mute Group *Playing* in every case, LED strength Strong/Max, scrolling the Project list to Screen Mirror, and starting AM Mod from the mpc-boot-thingy menu.

<!-- lang:ru -->
Am MOD r28e и установщик 1.3.0

AM Mod для Akai MPC Sample, прошивка 1.3.0.12. Основан на r28d; в этом релизе собрано всё, что появилось после r28d.

## Что нового после r28d

### Подсветка экрана Sample (только Pad lighting: Am MOD)

- У **Mute Group** те же режимы, что у Pad Link: Off / Selected / Playing / Both.
  - *Selected*: остальные пэды группы выбранного пэда поочерёдно мигают своим цветом и цветом Mute Group. Мигание начинается в момент выбора пэда (сначала цвет группы), игра его не скрывает.
  - *Playing*: когда пэд группы нажат или играет (в том числе от секвенсора), остальные пэды его группы вспыхивают цветом Mute Group на 300 мс.
- **Pad Link**: цели выбранного пэда поочерёдно мигают своим цветом и цветом Pad Link (Selected); цель коротко вспыхивает, когда начинает играть (Playing). Мигание прекращается, как только выбран другой пэд.
- Оба параметра по умолчанию **Selected**. Карты с уже сохранёнными настройками их сохраняют; Restore recommended (Pads) возвращает Selected/Selected.
- Для Offset больше нет особой подсветки.

### Mod Settings

- Вкладка **Colours**: отдельные цвета для Pad Link и Mute Group, новая настройка LED strength (Normal / Strong / Max) для блёклых цветов, редактор RGB-палитры показывает все 16 ячеек на полной яркости, выбранная ячейка мигает белым.
- **Pad lighting** — главная настройка: при Standard пункты Pad Link, Mute Group и все строки Colours серые и недоступны.

### Меню Project

- **Screen Mirror** перенесён из Mod Settings в меню Project (седьмая строка после Mod Settings). Список прокручивается штатно.
- Крупный шрифт и новые значки (нота для Key/Scale/Tempo, шестерёнка для Mod Settings, компьютер для Screen Mirror) — в одном из следующих релизов.

### Порт Screen Mirror (новое в r28e)

- Screen Mirror теперь слушает **порт 8081**: откройте `http://192.168.155.1:8081/` (раньше было 8080). Меню загрузки mpc-boot-thingy занимает `192.168.155.1:8080` для своей веб-страницы, поэтому вместе они работать не могли. После перезапуска Screen Mirror по-прежнему выключен. Спасибо lutikoff за замечание.

### Установщик 1.3.0 (отдельный файл `MPC-Sample-Mod-Installer.exe`)

- Интерфейс и описание релиза на английском и русском; описание и журнал установки всегда видны вместе.
- «Последний релиз» выбирает самый свежий релиз, где есть пакет мода.
- **Поддержка mpc-boot-thingy:** на карте с меню загрузки установщик добавляет AM Mod как приложение меню (`autorun/apps/am-mod/`), а не заменяет `autorun/`, так что меню загрузки продолжает работать. Чтобы запустить мод, выберите AM Mod в меню.

## Установка

Проще всего: запустите установщик, выберите SD-карту и нажмите «Установить». Вручную: распакуйте пакет и скопируйте папку `autorun` на SD-карту (exFAT или FAT32 с этим пакетом), затем включите MPC со вставленной картой. Только прошивка 1.3.0.12.

## Статус

Все проверки на хосте и в ARM/QEMU проходят. На устройстве проверено автором: мигание и вспышки Pad Link / Mute Group, Screen Mirror на порту 8081. Пока не подтверждено на железе: режим *Playing* у Mute Group во всех случаях, LED strength Strong/Max, прокрутка списка Project до Screen Mirror и запуск AM Mod из меню mpc-boot-thingy.

LA-2500/MPC-600-S.description: Sampler and sequencer OS for the Akai MPC Sample, based on the design of the MPC 3000 operating system. S600 MULTI multisample instruments with an Auto Sampler, Live Looper, 96 PPQN, MPC 3000/MPC60 swing, 7-44.1 kHz 4-16-bit sampling. C, aarch64 Linux; runs from SD card autorun.

releases.name: MPC 600 S, LA Version 1.3
releases.body:
**New: other MPCs' files, both ways.** Save/Load reads what an MPC 1000, MPC 2500 or MPC 500 saves, and writes projects an MPC 2500 loads.

- **MPC 2500 SEQUENCE** loads a sequence from an **.ALL** file (all of an MPC's sequences together) or a **.SEQ** (one on its own). Choose the sequence, then its tracks: they go onto the first empty tracks of the sequence on Into, nothing already there touched. Drum notes go back onto the pads they were played on, by the program file beside the .ALL; each track plays its own MPC program if it is loaded. An empty sequence takes the file's tempo (to the tenth of a BPM), time signature and length, and loops to bar 1. The MPC runs at 96 PPQN, as the MPC 600 S does, so notes land on exactly the same ticks.
- **MPC 2500 PROGRAM** loads a **.PGM** with its samples (the WAVs beside it, or a folder down or up): each pad's sample with its start, end and loop points, level, pan, tuning, play mode, mute group, envelope and filter. The message says how many WAVs were not found.
- **MPC 2500 PROJECT** loads a **.PRJ** whole, into what is empty: every program, then every sequence, each track on its own program. MPC 1000 and MPC 500 projects load too.
- **MPC 2500 PROJECT on SAVE** writes the project as a folder an MPC 2500 loads: the .PRJ, ALL_SEQS&SONGS.ALL (every sequence in its own number, up to 64 tracks), a .PGM for each program (pads A01-D16 and their settings), and every sample as a 16-bit 44.1 kHz WAV with its start and end. Pads in banks E-H and tracks past 64 are left out, and the message says how much.
- **MIDI FILE** loads a Standard MIDI File the same way: tracks chosen, onto the first empty tracks; SHIFT + push makes a track DRUM or KEYS.
- **SEQUENCE** saves and loads one sequence on its own, with all its tracks.
- Each MPC has its own types, named for it: these are for the MPC 2500, and read the MPC 1000's and MPC 500's files too, which are the same.
- The MPC types open at the top of the card, where an MPC's folders go. Each type remembers its folder and last item until power-off, so loading one after another stays put. B1 is <Up> out of a folder.

**Knob Mode** (Additional Settings 2): how K1-K3 and the slider take over a value. CATCH (as before: nothing moves until the knob reaches the value), JUMP (straight to the knob), SCALE (from where it is, meeting the knob at the ends).

**Timing Correct knobs:** K1 Swing (the SP12's six settings in SP12 mode), K2 Shift amount, K3 the Move Existing track.

**Also:** SHIFT + MUTE unmutes every track. SHIFT + ERASE opens Program Config with Copy started on the last pad pressed. Resample Start defaults to THRESHOLD; FORCE is now MANUAL. 16 Levels Tune's root starts on A08, so the pads play seven semitones down to eight up on bank A.

Install: extract MPC-600-S-OS-v1.3.zip and replace the autorun folder on the card. Your saved work, in MPC600S, is untouched.

releases.name: MPC 600 S, LA Version 1.2
releases.body:
**New: S600 MULTI, multisample instruments.** A third program Type (MPC, S600, S600 MULTI). One pad, the Instrument (Inst in Program Config), plays samples from the program's pads across the keyboard: up to 32 keygroups, each with two velocity zones, its root, tuning, level and pan; shared S600 envelopes, filter and LFO; key tracking (KEY>PAN, KEY>FILTER, KEY>LEVEL, KEY>ENV) with instrument templates. A keyboard view on the Keygroup page, K1 through the keygroups, keys and pads to set roots, ranges and zones.

**Auto Sampler:** play each note asked for ("Ready for Sample 1, Velocity 1"); <End>, <Re-Do>, <Skip>; at the end each sample's pitch is detected and everything is mapped by pitch and velocity, onto pads in pitch order. 12-bit mono at 29.76 kHz to start.

**Auto Map** builds the keygroups from the pads, the roots from file names and pitch detection; **Root Auto-Detect** gives S600 sounds their root note when loaded, so MIDI keys play them at true pitch. **S600** programs get an Instrument too (A01, or LAST PAD).

**S600 Mod page** (B2: Filter, LFO, Mod): the mod wheel on pitch (vibrato), filter (LFO movement, or OPEN: the cutoff opened) and level (tremolo), and the pitch bend range. The Main page: Poly, Legato, Portamento, Note On, Root Note (Auto-Detect).

**Insert effects** (mixer: SHIFT + B3 FX Sends, then SHIFT + B3 again): effects in any track's channel, in series before its fader, pan and sends. 8 insert slots shared across all tracks, each effect using what it costs (reverbs 4, amps, delays and modulation 2, EQs, dynamics and drives 1), with a live CPU meter. Saved with the project and included in exports.

**All On** envelope template, the new default for S600 sounds: full level from note start until release.

**Zone Assign TRANSIENT** (CHOP): a zone at every drum hit of a break, found at once: kicks, snares, hats and ghost notes, each zone starting just before its hit. Sensitivity 1-10, starts movable a millisecond at a time, <Delete> for a false hit.

**Loading a program** asks first, naming the program it goes into (the wheel picks another; <To Empty> loads into the first empty program).

**New: Live Looper.** On Audiotrack Record, B2 <Live Loop>: one-pass takes drop onto pads while the sequence keeps looping. Layer take after take without stopping; <Del Take> removes the last one. Live Loop Conversion (Additional Settings 2): IMMEDIATE converts during the pass, so the take drops in a few ms after it; AFTER 1ST LOOP drops in the raw take and converts while it plays, suited to longer takes.

**Footswitch AUDIO REC** (MIDI Settings, Sustain: FOOTSWITCH): the pedal is <Rec>/<Stop> on Audiotrack Record and Live Looper, and on any page once Live Looper takes have started.

**Footswitch setup** (MIDI Settings): Foot Chn (ANY to start, so any keyboard's pedal works), Foot CC (64 to start) and Polarity (AUTO works out a pedal that rests "down"; or NORMAL, INVERTED). <Learn> sets all three from one press of the pedal, and the bottom line shows what the pedal last sent.

**Additional Settings on two pages.** Page 2 holds Loop Conv and the start values for every recording page: Sample Rate (29.76 kHz; the slider's rates, or SET to any rate), Bit Rate (12), Anti-Aliasing and Normalize (on), Input Thru (always on, or off) and Rec Mode (stereo; Convert Sample stays mono).

**Metronome:** Audio Rec (click during audio track and Live Looper takes, default NO) and After Loop (click after a Live Looper take, default STOP).

**SAMPLE + pad** selects a pad without playing it in every mode (Note Repeat, Local Mode off, MIDI tracks): set a loop's volume without retriggering it.

**Fixed:** Master Effects are no longer kept in the settings file: they start off at power-on unless the Autoload project has them.

Install: extract **MPC-600-S-OS-v1.2.zip** and copy the `autorun` folder to the SD card root, replacing the old one. Your `MPC600S` folder is kept.

releases.name: GRIDZILLA 1.2.1
releases.body:
## Fixed in 1.2.1

Fixed “instrument load failed” on SD cards without development files. Instruments now use the engine included in the download, regardless of the card’s name. Older saved instrument and mixing-effect paths also load correctly.

All existing 1.2 features are included.

## Download

Get **GRIDZILLA-1.2.1.zip** below. It includes the installation folders, the step-by-step PDF and the video walkthrough. The guide and video are also available separately.

[Visit the GRIDZILLA download page](https://www.thesoundfactorynj.com/gridzilla)

GRIDZILLA adds instruments, MIDI editing, song arrangement, mixing and effect automation to the MPC Sample. It runs from SD without flashing Akai firmware.

## Mixer

Open it with SHIFT + Pad 5. Select a pad, move its fader, and use SHIFT for MUTE and SOLO while the Song plays. The mixer includes a MASTER channel, four insert slots and colored meters. Faders run from silence to +12 dB, with 0 dB at unity. Existing saved levels are retained.

## Effects

Add EQ, Saturation, Delay, Reverb, Limiter, the native compressor or Flex Beat. Click an occupied slot to open its controls, or an empty slot to choose an effect. Use presets as a starting point and adjust with the encoder. Removing an effect also removes its automation; Undo restores the edit.

## FX automation

Use TOUCH, LATCH or WRITE to record effect changes and READ to play them. Flex Beat supports MIX automation and individual ON/OFF points on the grid. Apply a point edit as one Undo action.

## Instruments and MIDI

16 LEVELS opens the instrument library and chord mode. Play single notes or one-pad chords from triads through 13ths. Edit the recorded notes in Melodic and change an existing instrument while the Song plays. Recording SNAP aligns new note starts to the selected grid; SNAP OFF keeps performed timing. Existing notes stay in place.

## Editing and navigation

Updated Grid and Melodic Tools, ADD SEQUENCE and sequence-position controls, direct access to occupied FX slots, Flex Beat BACK handling, and separation of Arranger controls from Sample loop/reverse settings.

## Download contents

The download contains the autorun and WaveGrid installation folders, the illustrated step-by-step PDF and the video walkthrough. Loose screenshots and technical reports are not included.

Stem export and the custom 2 Track-to-SD exporter are not included. Save your project and back up your SD card before installing. See the PDF for installation, updates and returning to a previous version.

## Download

- **Windows** (64-bit): `Trackyard-Setup-1.2.0.exe`

## New: pad sounds for Beat-Train

Beat-Train can mute the drum stem and play a real drum sound on each pad strike instead. In the editor, the ♪ button right of each row picks that row's sound from the song's own drum stem:

- It steps through the row's hits (‹ › or ←/→), best first: as few other drums at the same time as possible, ringing out freely, no ghost notes. Each one plays, and the cut is marked in its row.
- **Use this** picks it, **No sound** removes it; undo works as for notes.
- Save writes the picks to `sounds/` in the song folder: `kick.wav`, `red.wav`, `yellow.wav`, `blue.wav`, `orange.wav`, `green.wav`, named after the row colours.

A sound starts 1 ms before the hit's attack in the drum stem, found to the sample, and lasts as long as the hit rings, up to the next hit. With pad sounds on, Beat-Train mutes the whole drum stem, so a pad without a sound stays silent. Songs without a drum stem can't get pad sounds.

releases.name: v0.10.1 — SDK 0.7, Spectral Chop and MIDI fixes
releases.body:
## Features

MINIMOD is a Rust firmware mod built on the public `mpc-sample-sdk`. It includes 16 Levels chromatic MIDI, AutoTrim, the SAMPLE OPTIONS menu, HPSS, Spectral Chop, Reverb/Vinyl/Lo-Fi effects, eight synth characters, and a 16-pad Live Looper with recording, playback, overdub, and sync.

## Install

1. Download `minimod.zip` from this release.
2. Unzip it and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of an SD card.
3. Insert the card and power on the MPC Sample. Remove `autorun` and reboot to unload the mod.

## Changes in v0.10.1

- Pin `mpc-sample-sdk` v0.7.0 with exact slice snapshots, custom-end restoration, and native chop-mode restoration.
- Preserve existing slices and chop mode if Spectral Chop cannot write or verify markers; retain cancelled detection workers until they finish.
- Preserve native MIDI note-on/note-off pairs at chromatic replay capacity and across 16 Levels mode changes.
- Repaint directly only from live UI callbacks; background work requests frames through the UI repaint pump.

## Verification and compatibility

- `rust/check.sh`: formatting, strict Clippy, rustdoc, feature safety, 81 minimod tests, 63 DSP tests, and the AArch64 cross-build.
- `mod/build.sh`: release package, required symbols, unresolved imports, and MPC Sample glibc limit.
- Emulator: three menu navigation/close cycles, AutoTrim 3%/6%/9%/clear, Spectral Chop, and SDK Extract success/overwrite/full-program checks. The app did not restart during the interactive checks.
- Built for MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12** only.

releases.name: v0.10.0 — SDK 0.6.0 migration and the reported fixes
releases.body:
## SDK 0.6.0

MINIMOD is built on the tagged [`mpc-sample-sdk`
v0.6.0](https://github.com/ioma8/mpc-sample-sdk/tree/v0.6.0): independent input
hooks that run without the UI lock, one `Extract` contract for both the selected
and the generated paths, a checked late button replay, and a WAV reader that
accepts the sampler's own working copies.

## Fixes

- **Effects no longer leave the page in Chop mode.** An extraction that switches
  the Sample page is restored immediately, or on the first safe button when the
  app switches later.
- **"No exact WAV file" is gone.** The app's writer leaves the RIFF size short by
  the `atem`/`slic`/`meta` chunks it appends; the reader now bounds the chunk
  walk by the file, so every action works on streamed (`DiskSample`) pads and on
  pads created by an earlier action, not only on loaded ones.
- **A render cannot stick on "PLEASE WAIT" any more.** The repaint pump keeps
  asking for a frame while a job is pending, instead of relying on the one
  request the app can drop while it is loading a sample.
- **Pads no longer go silent after a few presses.** The firmware reports a pad
  press and its release with different source ids (`0` then `1`); the release
  ledger pairs them by pad and input, so the app receives its note-off again.
- **AutoTrim is armed on the real trim page.** It is available right after start
  and across `SAMPLE`, hidden on Tune and Filter, and `SHIFT`+`B3` no longer
  depends on having cycled the page keys first.

## Verification

- `rust/check.sh`: formatting, strict clippy, rustdoc, the feature safety guard,
  76 minimod tests, 63 DSP tests and the aarch64 cross build.
- SDK v0.6.0: 120 + 1 tests, clippy and rustdoc clean.
- Emulator suites: AutoTrim cycle and clear, menu, synth shift, pad octave, live
  looper and its lighting.

## Compatibility

Built for MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12** only. Copy the `autorun` folder from
the zip to the top level of the SD card; delete it to return to stock.

releases.name: v0.9.0 — synth page, lighting and precise loop timing
releases.body:
## Features

- **Rust implementation:** the preload library is a Rust `cdylib` built on the
  public memory-safe [`mpc-sample-sdk`](https://github.com/ioma8/mpc-sample-sdk);
  no C or C++ is compiled. The feature code uses only small, documented `unsafe`
  blocks at explicit SDK firmware boundaries.
- **16 Levels:** shift the pad row by ±8 semitones with PLUS/MINUS; external
  MIDI plays the selected sample chromatically over the whole keyboard from the
  sample's own root note (C3 when it has none), with exact semitones and no
  wrapping (enable Pad MIDI In in MIDI Config).
- **AutoTrim:** on the trim screen, SHIFT+B3 trims the page-selected sample's
  silent edges (3 %, 6 %, 9 %, then clear); the shifted Sample page shows the
  AutoTrim caption. Off the trim screen B3 reaches the app.
- **SAMPLE OPTIONS:** open with SHIFT+DATA, select with DATA, then press DATA
  to confirm.
  - **HPSS** splits a sample into harmonic and percussive layers on two free
    pads.
  - **Spectral Chop** detects musical changes and places slice boundaries on
    the selected sample.
  - **Add Reverb** creates a reverberated copy with an appended tail.
  - **Vinyl** and **Lo-Fi** apply the firmware's built-in H3 effects to a new
    copy.
  - **Synth** has eight selectable characters — bass, piano, pads, lead, bells,
    strings, voice and organ. Turn `DATA` to switch; each character has its own
    three knobs. The pads light in a purple 1→16 brightness gradient while the
    page is open, PLUS/MINUS shift by 8 semitones, the page shows the played
    note, and `DATA` renders the last previewed pad's note to a new pad (C2 by
    default).
  - **Live Looper** opens a fullscreen 16-pad looper: each pad records from the
    selected input source, plays, overdubs, clears with `ERASE`, and can be
    synced to a pulse built from the last loop's length. Device latency comes
    from the firmware's own period geometry; recordings use the input latency
    and overdubs use input + output. There is no manual trim.

## Install

1. Download `minimod.zip` from the release assets.
2. Unzip it and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of an SD card.
3. Insert the card and power on the MPC Sample. Remove `autorun` and reboot to
   unload the mod.

The release supports MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12** only.

## Changes in v0.9.0

### Synth page

- Light all sixteen pads in one purple hue while the synth page is open: pad 1
  is off, pad 16 is full brightness, and the steps between are linear. Every
  close path restores the app's native pad colours, including cancellation and
  the completion of a render.
- PLUS/MINUS shift the chromatic pad row by 8 semitones per press (four steps
  each way; both keys reset). The shift is reset when the page opens.
- Show the current note on the page. DATA renders the last previewed pad's note
  plus the current shift to a new pad; C2 is the default when no pad was played.
  Rendered sample names include the note, for example `Bass D2`.

### Live Looper

- Read the device latency from the firmware's own period geometry
  (`buffer - period`, 896 frames per direction) instead of adding the two ring
  capacities. Recordings compensate the input latency; overdubs compensate
  input + output; synced loops keep their phase across restarts.
- Remove the K1 manual latency trim. The settings file stores only MAIN VOLUME;
  an old `<trim> <master>` file keeps its master value.
- Keep the signed restart-phase fix.

### AutoTrim

- Arm the shortcut only on the trim screen; on the other Sample screens B3
  reaches the app unchanged.
- Resolve the target from the page's native selected pad (matched through the
  surface pad table, with sample identity as fallback), not from the last
  physical pad press.
- Restore the synth page's purple lights when a render closes the page.

### SDK

- Pin `mpc-sample-sdk` v0.5.3: directional device latency, per-pad AC50 RGB
  overrides with brightness and native restore, and a dedicated
  [pad lighting page](https://github.com/ioma8/mpc-sample-sdk/blob/main/docs/25-lighting.md).

## Verification and compatibility

- `rust/check.sh` passes formatting, strict clippy, rustdoc, feature safety,
  43 minimod tests, 49 DSP tests and the aarch64 cross build.
- SDK v0.5.3 passes 97 tests, including the lighting and directional-latency
  units.
- Emulator checks cover the synth gradient, cancel/render restoration,
  PLUS/MINUS semitone steps, the full synth sample render, AutoTrim's trim-screen
  and selected-pad paths, and the live looper suite.
- Built for MPC Sample firmware **1.3.0.12** only. Physical input/output
  latency still depends on the converters and is not calibrated by the
  emulator.

releases.name: MPC Sample draw handler addin v1.0.1
releases.body:
Owns the MPC Sample's screen for plugins that draw on it: the last plugin to ask gets the whole screen until it gives it back.

## Requirements

- A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else.
- **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit.
- Installing addins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk.

## Install

1. Unzip, then copy the whole folder to the device, e.g. `scp -r MPC-Sample-draw-handler-addin-1.0.1 root@<device-ip>:/tmp/`
2. Run it: `ssh root@<device-ip> sh /tmp/MPC-Sample-draw-handler-addin-1.0.1/install.sh`

The installer copies the addin into `/data/mpc-addins/sample-draw-handler/`, adds `mpc_sample_draw_handler.so` to the `LD_PRELOAD` list of MPC's service
and **restarts MPC** (save your project first). The list is extended, never replaced: other addins and the
libraries the firmware preloads stay. Where no writable file sets the list (the unit is on the read-only root), one
drop-in shared by every addin sets it, `/etc/systemd/system/<service>.service.d/90-mpc-addins.conf`. Re-run the
installer after a firmware update. `-y` skips the question, `-n` leaves the restart to you.

Settings are in `/data/mpc-addins/sample-draw-handler/mpc_sample_draw_handler.conf`; an upgrade keeps your edits.

On the MPC Sample it now owns the screen for plugins and addins that draw on it; a long hold of PAD FX cycles their pages. Control (on the device): http://127.0.0.1:6740/status, /test?on=1 shows a test pattern, /release gives MPC its screen back. From a computer: ssh -L 6740:127.0.0.1:6740 root@<device address>.

Uninstalling and the file list are in `INSTALL.md` inside the zip.


## Changes in 1.0.1

- After a page gave the screen back, parts of it could stay on the glass under MPC's waveform. MPC double-buffers its
  screen and redraws only what changed, so each framebuffer now keeps its own copy of MPC's pixels (seen on an MPC Sample,
  2026-11-06).

---
Built from jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler@c7f3960 with mpc-vst-plugins (tools/release-aarch64.sh). Tested on an MPC Sample (firmware 1.3.0.12) on 2026-11-06.

releases.name: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.2.0
releases.body:
**MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.2.0.** Hold 16 Levels (about a second) to turn Scale on or off; with Scale on, the 16 Levels slots play a scale, shown on the SCALE page.

Changes since 1.1.0:
- **The page is Scale.** A hold turns Scale and the SCALE page on together, and the next hold turns both off: MPC's screen comes straight back (it used to linger a few seconds, and closing the page with the dial left Scale on). A dial press now exits Scale too. If another page took the screen while Scale is on, a hold brings the SCALE page back.
- **Input lock.** While Scale is on, buttons and knobs no longer reach MPC, so nothing changes MPC's screen or parameters under the page (before, the knobs moved the sample's trim and other settings). The pads, 16 Levels, Shift, the transport (Rec, Overdub, Stop, Play, Play Start), notes 84-87 and the page's own keys, dial and K1-K3 still work. `lock_input=0` turns the lock off; `pass_notes` lists the buttons that get through. Each control kept from MPC is logged with its note.
- `padctl raw [n]` logs the raw control-surface input to MPC's journal.

Checked on an MPC Sample, firmware 1.3.0.12 (2026-11-09): the hold toggle and the input lock, by hand and with injected presses. Notes 84-87 are believed to be the bank buttons; not confirmed yet.

Needs [mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler) **1.0.1** or later for the page. The installer's `LD_PRELOAD` drop-in on the Sample is on `/run`, so reinstall after a reboot (or restore it from the SD card's autorun).

releases.name: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.1.0
releases.body:
**MPC Sample Scale Mode** (was Enable Scale Mode). **Hold 16 Levels** (about a second) to turn Scale on or off. With Scale on, the 16 Levels slots play a scale instead of their usual steps. A short press is still a normal 16 Levels press, and Shift+16 Levels still cycles the Type.

![The SCALE page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-scalemode/7f5c90324dbc6f3458eb17466a265d5992d2fade/docs/screenshots/scale-page.png)

Holding 16 Levels also opens a **SCALE page**. It shows the notes every slot plays and lights the one you hit; the soft keys pick scale, root or octave, the dial changes it, K1-K3 set them directly, and a dial press closes it. It stays up while Scale is on.

Needs [mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-draw-handler) **1.0.1** or later for the page. Without it, the hold still toggles Scale.

**Upgrading from Enable Scale Mode 0.x:** the addin was renamed, so uninstall the old one first: `sh /data/mpc-addins/enable-scalemode/uninstall.sh`. While the old one is loaded, this one stays off and says so in MPC's log. Settings start fresh.

Changes since 1.0.0:
- **Always by ear.** `detect_pitch=always` (or `padctl detect always`) listens to every sample, not only untagged ones, and the note heard wins over the file's tag: for samples tagged with the wrong note. Checked on a Moog lead tagged D that sounds C#: with root A, slot 0 sounded G# by the tag and A by ear. A sample with no clear pitch keeps MPC's root note either way.
- `detect_pitch` takes `untagged` (the default, as in 1.0.0), `always` or `off` (0/1/2 still work); `padctl detect` shows or sets it and saves it to the conf.

Tested on an MPC Sample, firmware 1.3.0.12 (2026-11-06): the device test passes 19 of 19 from this zip, with every slot's pitch and the pad latency measured from the USB audio. The installer's `LD_PRELOAD` drop-in on the Sample is on `/run`, so reinstall after a reboot.

RHYTHMER OS for MPC Sample — 0.4.0-beta.3.

## Workflow

- On native Sample Kit SOUND/TRIM, encoder Push opens TRACK TYPE if all 128 pads and layers are empty. SAMPLE KIT starts first-sample loading. If other pads contain samples, Push opens SAMPLES for the selected empty pad. Screen hints show both routes.
- Loaded/layered pads, other editors, recording/Freeze guards, Break loop entry and contextual Note Repeat controls keep their existing jobs. Shift + Push cancels the browser; B1 goes up folders or exits at the root. Sample load Undo preserves other pads.
- Preset lists and main PRESETS browsing wrap in both directions using the encoder or Minus/Plus. Folder lists wrap within the current folder. User Sound/User Kit remain included; absolute pot selection and existing load timing are unchanged.

## Acid Engine

The four original Hortator Acid sounds are retained. Eight unmodified Aphex factory choices are also available: **Acid Squelch, Lead Scream, Whistle Lead, Resonant Spike, Acid Seq, Reso Bass, Filter Cry and Techno Pulse**. They use the original Aphex DSP, native filters and source edit parameters. Source identity and edits persist in projects and User Sound; Rhythmer Kit pad source/restore is also covered.

## Validation

ARM64 build; 19 runtime unit tests; 290 track/input/navigation assertions; GEN/Acid/Break integration; audio self-test; 36,000 random surface moves; 430 UI previews with no text issues. Host regressions cover single instruments, 36 kits, engine/kit filters and 4,587 control round trips. All eight aliases match original Aphex control values and pass five-note output, project/User Sound and pad-source restore checks under ASan/UBSan for the host code. Original native DSP libraries are unchanged and not all are sanitizer-instrumented. Signed-update identity and tamper checks pass.

releases.name: RHYTHMER OS 0.4.0-beta.3 — Break workflow hotfix.2
releases.body:
RHYTHMER OS for MPC Sample — 0.4.0-beta.3 / Break workflow hotfix.2.

The app version remains **0.4.0-beta.3**. This separate release record identifies the matching installation files and corresponding source. The Sound / Kit save hotfix is included.

## Break: load, find the controls, play

- Loading or reloading source A makes a straight sixteen-chop pattern and stays in **BREAK GEN**, with **BRK PERF** selected. Push / B3 OPEN enters the performance pages.
- While decoding, **B1 CANCEL** or **SHIFT + encoder Push** cancels track assignment. Other generator actions and knob cards wait until loading finishes. A cached decoded file may remain; a cancelled request cannot replace the track.
- Source A/B completion does not reopen a dismissed menu or pull you away from another track. Replacing/deleting the target track continues to invalidate pending loads.
- Reopen controls from the Break track: **SEQ / PATTERNS → SHIFT + B3 GEN → BREAK GEN → BRK PERF**. In BRK PERF, B1 GEN returns to BREAK GEN. BACK / Shift + Push returns to main GEN, then closes it.
- **Pattern Hold** replaces the misleading LOOP HOLD label. It holds the internal generated pattern in LOOP mode, not audio sustain or track Freeze. The stored parameter and DSP behavior are unchanged. CHOP mode and zero variation can make the difference inaudible.
- Grain / Splice / Slow explicitly describe stretched hits. With playback running, hold Pad 3 STRETCH on ROLLS, keep it held while paging to GRAIN, adjust the controls and release; recorded STRETCH works too. Pattern Hold is not required.
- Rejected/undecodable files return to the owned browser for retry without replacing the previous instrument. A track frozen during decoding cancels assignment without a late Unfreeze dialog.
- All six pages have clearer operating hints. SOURCE B requires a loaded B file; TRACK MIX changes the track mix rather than generating a pattern. RETURN clears Variation/Drift while keeping the selected A/B source.
- General GEN also saves the Acid RNG stream with its Undo/Redo operation, keeping the generated notes and random state together. The generation algorithm and seed policy are unchanged.

## Install and learn

Use the **full SD ZIP**, verify its SHA-256 and back up the entire card first. The signed UPDATE ZIP is app-only and is not a first-install package; the native updater may not offer a same-version hotfix. Target: MPC Sample AC50 / stock firmware 1.3.0.12. No break recordings are bundled.

## Validation scope

Software checks cover cancellation, A/B async ownership, current-track navigation, Undo/Redo, project save/reload, held STRETCH release after paging, CHOP/LOOP pattern hold, grain processing, existing track workflows, runtime tests, audio self-test, random surface inputs and native UI text/layout. Exact results and source identity are recorded in the validation receipt. Current software results: 19 runtime tests, 161 track-workflow assertions, three final fresh-process GEN/Acid/Break passes, 430 standard UI states with zero reported text issues, 12 × 3,000 random surface inputs, 16 original roll commands and 2,400 Acid reference cases. All 41 plug-in binaries and eight sample files are unchanged. Engine DSP, preset banks and serialized control IDs remain unchanged from the prior reviewed hotfix. releases.body:
First release of MPCTRACKER, a pattern tracker for the Akai MPC Sample that runs from an SD card.

It has eight tracks and 64 sample slots, and it uses the ProTracker effect column. It loads WAV files and 4 to 8 channel .mod files, saves songs to the card, and starts with a short VHS style intro that any pad skips. The README has the full list of controls.

## Installing

1. Read the Safety section of the README, save the project that is open on the sampler and back up the card.
2. Unzip `mpctracker-v0.1.0-sd-card.zip` and copy the `autorun` and `tracker` folders to the root of the SD card. This replaces any `autorun` folder that is already on the card.
3. Put WAV files in `tracker/samples`, or browse to samples that are already on the card.
4. Insert the card. The tracker starts a few seconds after the sampler has booted.
5. Hold SHIFT and press STOP to quit back to the sampler. Take the card out and power cycle for a normal boot.

## Notes

This was developed against the emulator on firmware 1.3.0.12. It starts and plays sound on a real unit, but most of the hardware testing is still to do, so expect rough edges. It never touches the sampler's internal storage and it only writes inside the `tracker` folder on the card.

The zip has no demo song. A first run plays a built-in drum kit and groove. Copy a `.mod` file into `tracker/songs` before the first start and it opens that instead.

Still to come are sampling from the inputs, block copy and paste, a fill tool, naming songs on the device, a view of all eight tracks at once, and MIDI.

SHA-256 of the zip: `f42ab51ecc7c829ed667e0b46e2d4330170781643131bbb40d92cb1a89e50277`

releases.name: Melodee 0.2.2
releases.body:
Melodee 0.2.2 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

## Update

- **From 0.2.0 or 0.2.1:** copy `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.2.zip` to the card, or send it from the web page at http://melodee.local. Melodee asks *Update to v0.2.2?*, saves, installs and restarts.
- **From 0.1.0 or a new card:** install by hand as in the [0.2.0 notes](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample/releases/tag/v0.2.0): unzip and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of the card.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**.

## New

- **Layer play: Cycle hold and Random hold** (Stage LAYERS, **SHIFT** + **K1**). They pick a layer like Cycle and Random, but while Note Repeat repeats the pad, every repeat plays the layer the first one picked until you let go.
- **Stage ARP: SHIFT + K2** turns the arpeggiator on or off.

## Changed

- **Note Repeat is no longer the arpeggiator.** It plays every pad held together on each step, as on the MPC. Before, two pads held took turns: a kick pressed over rolling hats played only every other step and halved the hats. The arpeggiator keeps its modes, rate, octaves, gate and hold on Stage ARP, and Note Repeat no longer turns it on.

## Fixed

- Note Repeat and the arpeggiator play each note on its exact frame. Before, a note landed at the start of the audio block it fell in, so repeats were uneven by up to 3 ms. Swung repeats and MIDI out are exact too.

releases.name: Melodee 0.2.1
releases.body:
Melodee 0.2.1 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

## Update

- **From 0.2.0:** copy `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.1.zip` to the card, or send it from the web page at http://melodee.local. Melodee asks *Update to v0.2.1?*, saves, installs and restarts.
- **From 0.1.0 or a new card:** install by hand as in the [0.2.0 notes](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample/releases/tag/v0.2.0): unzip and copy the `autorun` folder to the top level of the card.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**.

## New

- **Settings > LIGHTS:** Pad lights, Pad fade (100 ms by default, faster than before) and the Tap Tempo light on or off.
- **Settings > PADS > Repeat velocity:** Note Repeat plays at the strike velocity or follows pad pressure.
- **Web page:** installed plug-ins are listed with a delete button on each.

## Faster

- Idle plug-ins sleep: an instrument with no key held while stopped, or an effect with no signal, stops running after half a second of silence.
- Plug-in rate conversion at 48 and 96 kHz takes a tenth of the time.
- Kit voices, instrument zones, built-in effects and Room/Reverb/Plate run lighter loops; output is sample for sample the same. A busy kit bench runs 14% faster.

## Fixed

- **Warp by Time (Tones)** sounds cleaner: windows line up in phase, pitched-up reads are band-limited, and each hit plays once and on time, also around a kit pad's loop and in instrument zones.
- Note Repeat plays on the press when the sequencer is stopped.
- Step Edit lights pads under 16 Levels and as they play, names a level's pitch or velocity, marks sounding notes and records the keys a pad played.
- Pad lights fade out when the sound stops, instead of going dark at a one-shot's end; same for 16 Levels pads.
- Cloud is set per pad, not per kit. Older kits' Cloud setting is copied onto every pad.
- A plug-in's chosen preset is saved with the project, so PRESETS shows it again after a restart.
- Choosing the mic as input turns Monitor off only while the speaker plays; with headphones or line out plugged in, Monitor stays on.
- Project page: SD card access is the first row of every folder and reads mounted / eject; entering a folder selects its first entry; dot files and folders are hidden.
- Sample cache cleans up partial files and files not played for 30 days.
- Web Files tab hides the `autorun` and `sample-base` folders.

## Files

- `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.1.zip`: the `autorun` folder for the card, and the update file. Its README and licences are inside, in `autorun/melodee/`.
- `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.1.zip.sha256`: its checksum.

Melodee is made by Kerem Kiliç (Ellic Studio). Free software under the AGPL-3.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by inMusic or Akai Professional.

releases.name: Melodee 0.2.0
releases.body:
Melodee 0.2.0 for the Akai MPC Sample: a 16-track groovebox that runs on the MPC in place of the stock app, from the microSD card.

![Melodee screens on the MPC Sample](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keremimo/melodee-sample/main/docs/images/melodee-promo.png)

## Before you install

- **Coming from 0.1.0?** 0.1.0 cannot update itself. Install 0.2.0 by hand once, as below. From 0.2.0 on, Melodee installs new releases for you.
- **Plug-ins have moved.** Melodee now reads plug-ins from `Melodee/Plugins` on the card. Move the contents of the old top-level `Plugins` folder there; saved projects find them in either place.

## Install

1. Download `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.0.zip` below.
2. Back up the card. If the card already has an `autorun` folder at its top level, move it somewhere safe.
3. Unzip the release. It holds one folder, `autorun`. Copy that folder to the top level of the card. Do not edit or rename anything inside it.
4. Put the card in the MPC and switch it on. The stock app starts first. A few seconds later Melodee starts.

Requires an MPC Sample on firmware **1.3.0.12**. On any other firmware Melodee does not start and the stock app keeps running. Melodee changes nothing on the MPC itself: delete the `autorun` folder and the stock app runs as before.

New to Melodee? Read the [quickstart](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md), then the [user guide](https://github.com/keremimo/melodee-sample/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md). Both are also on the MPC's own web page (below).

## New

- **Updates from the card.** Copy a release zip to the card; Melodee asks *Update to <version>?*, saves, installs and restarts. The previous version stays in `autorun/melodee.prev`.
- **Web page at http://melodee.local.** Connect the MPC to a computer by USB-C while Melodee runs: send updates and plug-in zips, read the quickstart and manual, and use **Files** to browse the card, play, download, upload and delete.
- **Screen Mirror** (Settings > SCREEN): the MPC shows up as a USB webcam with Melodee's screen, at 30 or 60 fps and up to 1280 x 960.
- **LV2 and CLAP plug-ins**, as instruments and effects, beside VST3 and VST2, with their presets. The plug-in picker browses the whole card.
- **Plug-ins hear Melodee's transport** (play, position, tempo, time signature). **TRANSPORT** keeps Play and Stop from a plug-in with its own sequencer.
- **Freeze and deep freeze.** Print a track to audio and play it from the card; deep freeze also unloads its plug-ins.
- **Pad sends.** Kit pads send into buses A–D on their own, after Pad FX; MPC drum programs' Send 1–4 come in with them.
- **128 patterns a track** in eight banks (A–H). **Patterns** is SEQ's home, drawn as the pads sit: launch patterns from the pads and scenes from the wheel and Push. Shift + Pad 12 opens Song.
- **MIDI in everywhere.** Each track listens on its own channel and port; Remote CCs select tracks and launch patterns and scenes. A keyboard's pitch wheel bends plug-in tracks.
- **Roll** marks notes for velocity ramps, grid pull, octave moves, copy, split, legato, reverse and arp.
- **16 Levels** turns on in place, with Zones for drum and percussion instruments.
- **Chop** finds hits from the spectrum, cuts before the attack, and Beats cuts at the sample's own tempo.
- **Samples:** MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis and AIFF load and preview; stereo waveforms show both sides.
- **Neural Amp Modeler** as an optional plug-in beside the built-in amp sim.
- **Pad colours** from MPC kits and from Stage's COLOUR. **Light show** on Sample + Mute.
- **Crash reports** go to `Melodee/Crashes` on the card. Please attach one when you report a crash.

## Fixed

- Soft pad hits play quieter (velocity scales the level linearly).
- Monitoring joins the mix before the master chain, as loud as the take plays back; Rec Input FX are heard while monitoring.
- A pad hit in the count-in's last sixteenth records on the take's first tick, as long as it was held.
- All notes off no longer crashes CLAP plug-ins such as Surge XT.
- Factory kits and demos on the internal drive load.
- DecentSampler presets open with their controls' starting values.
- Loading a file from the browser no longer plays it twice.
- Tempo changes are one undo step each.

## Removed

- Pad Punch. Pad FX pressed again stays on the punches; older projects' per-pad punches are skipped on load.

## Files

- `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.0.zip`: the `autorun` folder for the card. Its README and licences are inside, in `autorun/melodee/`.
- `Melodee-MPC-Sample-v0.2.0.zip.sha256`: its checksum.

Melodee is made by Kerem Kiliç (Ellic Studio). Free software under the AGPL-3.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by inMusic or Akai Professional.

releases.body:
A proof of concept of sample-base's demos that starts from the microSD card: no computer, SSH or network connection needed.

**Requires MPC Sample firmware 1.3.0.12 exactly.** On anything else the demos do not start and the stock app keeps running.

### Install
1. Back up the card. Move any existing top-level `autorun` folder (MPC Sample Plugins, Melodee) somewhere safe: this one replaces it.
2. Copy the `autorun` folder from the zip to the top level of the card. Don't edit or rename anything inside: the MPC refuses an autorun whose files changed.
3. Switch the MPC on. The stock app starts first; a few seconds later the demos take over the screen.

**Push the wheel** to go back to stock until the next boot. Delete the `autorun` folder to uninstall. A crash or failed start also brings stock back; nothing on the MPC itself changes, only the card.

### What's in it
- Pads play a 16-voice sine/triangle synth in C major; external MIDI plays it too
- **Sample**: record Line in, Mic or USB-C for up to 60 s and play it back
- **Pad FX**: a light show over every LED on the surface
- **16 Levels**: pad velocity and pressure
- **SEQ**: eight-drum, sixteen-step sequencer
- **Knob FX**: live system dashboard

### Files
`sample-base-demos-MPC-Sample-v0.1.0.zip`, SHA256 `d338960d4eb3b8d9129b7ba3e513fe1fbda6d455081a00d21ddb0003ca576652` (also in the `.sha256` asset). Built from 34f8fc7. AGPL-3.0-only, JUCE under AGPLv3; licences are in the zip. Not affiliated with inMusic or Akai Professional.

releases.name: SampleBoot 1.0.0
releases.body:
**One card, every OS.** SampleBoot is a boot menu for the Akai MPC Sample: the stock firmware and every custom OS (Melodee, SampQOL OS, MPC Simple, …), in as many versions as you like, live on the same SD card. Turn the encoder, push it, and the system you chose starts. No more swapping cards or moving `autorun` folders around.

Tested on firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12). SampleBoot changes nothing on the MPC: without the card, it starts as stock. **Back up your SD card before installing.**

### Install
1. Download `SampleBoot-1.0.0.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Copy its `autorun` folder to the top level of the SD card.
3. Copy each OS's own `autorun` folder into `autorun/mods/` and rename it, e.g. `autorun/mods/Melodee 0.2.2/`.

Full instructions in the [README](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot#install).

### In this release
- Splash screen drawn line by line (dark, light, your own or off), then a full-screen boot menu with each system's image, encoder control, countdown with beeps that follow the Main Volume knob, switch-off from POWER
- Switches off the pad and button lights left on by the previous app
- Add an OS by copying a folder; several versions side by side; custom name and image per system
- Falls back to the stock app if a system does not start; restores every audio setting it touches
- Every colour configurable in `sampleboot.conf`, plus `tools/theme-editor.html`, an offline page that previews every screen exactly as the MPC draws it
- `tools/add_mod.py`, an optional helper that adds OSes straight from their release zips

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/pxcm/SampleBoot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for everything.

SampleBoot ships no custom OS: download them from their own projects. Not affiliated with inMusic Brands or Akai Professional.
